name: xiuxian-desktop
description: 牛马修仙传 - PC Desktop Edition

scripts.build:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join(__dirname,'..','build','web-desktop');const dst=p.join(__dirname,'build','web-desktop');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied web-desktop build')}else{console.error('Run Cocos build first: npm run pc:build');process.exit(1)}"
